lines: - "First Jarka had the Queens in her head. Then Jarka had the Worms in her head. Then Kahl free Jarka. Now... nothing in Jarka's head but Jarka. Echo echo echo."
- "Jarka is lining up all her bad thoughts. She is putting a big sun above them so she can see them clearly. Then Jarka get her lovely Vulkar. Then shoot them one by one."

- "Jarka stood in her high watchtower and looked out into the night. And somewhere in the night a walking thing called out in a great big voice all lonely and sad. And Jarka wanted so much to call back to it and say hello, Jarka hears you, she is here too. She is lonely too."
- "Tenno. Tenno in the camp. Jarka has eyes on them. Tracking. Nobody engage. It will probably go away if we all pretend we have not seen it."
- "Okay. Does everyone see the Tenno? Listen. Jarka has dealt with them before. Wait until it starts mining. Or fishing. Then attack!"
- "Kela de Thaym said Jarka's marksmanship was 'adequate'! The Kela de Thaym!"
- "Jarka gets confused sometimes. She forgets this war is over now. She shot Kahl. But Kahl says it is okay. Jarka can stay."
- "Chipper is funny. Sometimes Jarka gets two wrenches and plays Skeg drums on his head! The Queens! They must never know Jarka likes Skeg."
- "Jarka wants to go back to the lake and float upside down like a fishy."
Jarka Lar: "The Corpus boy is easy target. Very slow and very stupid."
- Jarka Lar: "Or is he? Perhaps it is all Jarka's clever trap. Perhaps anything that comes for the Corpus boy will DIE! Safer just to walk away, yes."
- "Jarka was captured. Packed into ramsled and sent to die. Jarka is most happy to find Tenno."
- "Tenno? Jarka was stuck in ramsled too long, thinking about Tenno friend. Then, surprise, Jarka crashes into friend."
- "Jarka wonders what took you so long."
- "Jarka thinks we'll be friends. If not, Jarka kills you. But probably friends."
- "Jarka wonders why everyone is just standing around?"
- "Jarka wonders who is out there in all that blackness? Who... what?"
- "Jarka thinks the Railjack is just like... just like Grineer crewship, only shinier."
- "Fire out. Jarka smells all smokey now."
- "New hole in hull is big problem."
- "Uninvited guests. Rude. Jarka hates bad manners."
- "Railjack is full of scum. Clean Railjack."
- "Intruders. Jarka will smother them like a bad thought."
- "Jarka feels better. Ready to kill again."
- "Jarka got tired of waiting. Jarka fixed self."
- "We lost a good one. Jarka cries."
- "Crew down. Jarka cannot stand to lose any more friends."
- "Jarka thinks something is wrong with Railjack? Very wrong."
- "Jarka wonders if Railjack can take much more beating."
